title: Tyree Glenn turns up in California
summary: Tyree Glenn knocked on his door offering to play trombone just when Barefield needed a first trombonist for his band in California.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: And Tyree Glen, remember -- I remember when he first came to California. I was putting -- organizing my band, and one night I was sitting up writing music, and a knock came on the door and it was Tyree Glen. He said, Mr. Barefield, I hear that you're putting together a band. I'm a trombone player. And he was a godsend because there's no trombone players out there at the time. He came right in time to play the first chair, the trombone in my band out there.
Where had he come from, then?
I don't know, because he had been around -- from around Washington, D. C., something like that, but I don't know how it happened he just come out, how he happened to get to California.
